observed_assets: MCF examples include uncertainty fields but only as qualitative text.
Function OS schemas mention probabilistic representations but do not define probability semantics.
Foundation classifies PROBABILISTIC_MODEL objects and downgrades uncalibrated probability claims.
Legacy math-foundation inventory contains exit probability, collision probability, entropy, phase transition, and system stability objects.
Q12-Q14 provide mechanism, distribution, attractor, compression, and map boundaries but not executable transition laws.

gaps.description: No object distinguishes aleatoric probability, epistemic uncertainty, measurement error, sampling variation, subjective prior, posterior, and unknown probability source.
No first-class system boundary, environment, input, output, exchange, nested-system, observer-frame, or purpose-of-model object.
No executable state-space and transition-law structure for deterministic, stochastic, or hybrid dynamics.
No schema-level separation of observational conditionals from intervention distributions.
No probability calibration record, rare-event tail record, or rule that high probability is not causal proof.
No guard against silently assuming Markov, stationarity, ergodicity, linearity, Gaussian noise, or closed-system boundaries.

claim_ceiling: This ledger establishes a representation and execution gap only; it does not validate any new probabilistic or system-dynamic causal claim.
